layers.process: Hagia Sophia History and Experience Museum (Ayasofya Tarih ve Deneyim Müzesi, on Sultanahmet Square, a separate building from the mosque): entry €25, about A$39.73 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = EUR 0.6293). The MüzeKart museum pass is not valid there. Open 9 am to 8 pm; the ticket office closes at 7 pm.

sources.title: Hagia Sophia History and Experience Museum
sources.authority: Ministry of Culture and Tourism, Türkiye (muze.gov.tr)
sources.supports: fee, MüzeKart not valid, hours (read directly 2026-11-05)

zone-requirements.note: The foreign visitor fee for the Hagia Sophia mosque itself (reported in 2024 news as €25) was not found on a ministry or Diyanet page, so it is not recorded.
